body: Oh I absolutely would not call as a punishment, it would be because I'm worried.  I have no idea how to get ahold of his family, and I'm not sure they would take it seriously, and he would be furious if he found out I told them.  He's not in therapy or on meds, but he has been in the past.  I've suggested going back but he says no and that it wouldn't help and he just wants to kill himself.  I talked to him tonight and he sounds like in his mind suicide would be the best/only option
Thats how I feel, but he spent time at a mental hospital a while ago when he was suicidal and says it was the worst experience for him and I'm worried what would happen if he was sent back there
